QUOTE: `staleness` is attached to replies only when a notice exists (`DocsDbServer.staleness_notices`, `server.py:1548`, and `QueryTools._staleness`, `tools_query.py:1886`). A current index adds nothing, so the field stays a signal.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the annotation is attached to query replies automatically and is absent when the index is current. The opening line also says "an annotation on every query reply".
